text:
Sam P: Quick heads-up — seeing an 8-12% p99 regression on the multi-arch pool since the kernel-autotune rollout this morning. perf report: https://perf.internal/reports/4810002 :eyes:
perf-bot: alert — throughput drop detected for model/gpt-stream (canary group) at 11:41 UTC. Affected nodes: n7,n12,n19. Metric: tokens/s down ~9%.
Anya L: Yikes. Any evidence it's related to batching heuristics vs kernel pick?
Kevin R: Microprofile attached — seems sequence-length-dependent. At seqlen ≈ 110 the runtime flipped kernel path from tensor-core fp16 optimized to a generic bf16 kernel, and kvcache behavior changed.
Sam P: here's the canary config we pushed (excerpt):
```json
{
  "kernel_policy": "auto",
  "seqlen_thresholds": [64, 128],
  "prefer_tensor_cores": true,
  "batch_window_ms": 6
}
```
Kevin R: Logs show the path switch then immediate prefix eviction churn:
```
[11:41:23] kvcache: evicting prefix 0..64 due to kernel_path_change
[11:41:24] kernel-switch: chosen=generic_bf16, prev=tc_fp16_fast
[11:41:25] perf: p50=22ms p99=410ms -> p99=485ms
```
Morgan: That eviction at the moment of the kernel flip explains the latency spike — cold KV reads + incompatible kernel optimized for different dtype/layout.
Anya L: Do we have hysteresis in the kernel decision logic? If noisy sequence-length sampling toggles picks, we could thrash between kernels.
Kevin R: Currently it's instantaneous — the autotuner chooses per-request based on sampled seqlen distribution. No sticky mapping.
Sam P: Observed pattern: mixed-farm (SM75 + SM86 + SM98) made heuristics prefer tensor cores on some nodes and BF16 fallback on others. Multi-node requests that hit different kernel families are worse.
Anya L: Proposal: add two changes — 1) local sticky kernel binding per model instance for N minutes, 2) require 2 consecutive seqlen-bucket samples before switching.
Morgan: Also add kvcache compatibility check: if kernel ABI/layout would invalidate cached KV, prevent switch until cache flush complete or do warmup.
Kevin R: Quick patch I tested locally: add seqlen hysteresis counter and delay switch by 1 batch. Microbench looks promising (p99 regained ~6%).
Sam P: Action: revert canary flag on hosts n7,n12 for now, roll the hysteresis patch to a small canary (n19) and run 30m load test. Kevin, can you prepare a PR?
Kevin R: On it — PR draft with tests and microbench results by EOD. Will include telemetry to correlate kernel switches<>kvcache-evicts.
Anya L: Also add a telemetry event for "kernel_switch_caused_cache_eviction" so alerts can tie them.
perf-bot: noted — new alert rule suggestion queued: high kernel_switch_rate + kvcache_eviction_rate => perf-investigate. :white_check_mark:
Sam P: Thanks all. Ping me when PR is up and when we've got the rollback on canary.
Morgan: I'll queue the rollback and update the runbook.
Anya L: Nice catch, this is why we need model-instance sticky heuristics. :thumbsup:
Sam P: will follow up with postmortem if it persists.
